plan_rules.§2 Eligible dependents: Legal spouse or registered domestic partner; children under 26; disabled children of any age with certification. Parents, siblings and fiancé(e)s are not eligible.
plan_rules.§5.1 Mid-year changes: Allowed only for a qualifying life event (QLE) and must be requested within 31 days of the event, except as provided in §5.2.
plan_rules.§5.2 Extended window: Birth, adoption, placement for adoption, and loss of other group coverage: request within 60 days. Loss of coverage due to non-payment of premiums or voluntary cancellation is not a QLE.
plan_rules.§5.3 Required proof: Marriage: marriage certificate. Birth: birth certificate or hospital record. Loss of coverage: certificate of creditable coverage, or a letter from the prior employer or plan showing the coverage end date and the reason coverage ended.

benefits_faq.When does coverage start after a mid-yea: Coverage for a newly added dependent starts the first of the month after Benefits approves the request, or on the event date for birth and adoption.
benefits_faq.Can I change my plan mid-year?: Only if the change is consistent with the qualifying event. Adding a spouse allows moving from Employee only to Employee + Spouse, but not switching from the PPO to the HDHP.
benefits_faq.What if my documents are in another lang: Submit a certified translation together with the original document.

Agent (Tom): Sorry to hear that. I see your separation in the system dated 09/11. Your active coverage runs through the end of the month of separation.
Caller: OK. And after that? I heard there's a continuation thing.
Agent (Tom): Yes, continuation coverage. You'll get an election notice by mail from our administrator, Keystone Benefit Services. It explains the options and premiums.
Caller: Has it been sent yet? I haven't gotten anything.
Agent (Tom): I don't see a mail date for the notice yet in this screen. I'd give it a couple of weeks.
Caller: The appointments are Tuesday, I really can't have them cancelled, my daughter's been in pain for days.
Agent (Tom): Understood. I'd keep the appointment.
Caller: And my severance - is that going to have the insurance taken out?
Agent (Tom): I'm not able to see severance details here, you'd need to ask HR.

inquiry.text: Can you tell me why Wen's check was held in the Q3 payroll audit? She's asking me every day and says she didn't change anything.

audit_memo.title: Q3 Payroll Exception Audit - Retail Division
audit_memo.summary: The audit sampled pay records for July-August across 42 stores. Exceptions were coded per the legend and routed to Payroll Operations for tracking. Held checks are released once the exception is cleared by the owner shown in the legend. Stores should not contact employees about security holds; Payroll Security will reach out directly.

exceptions.detail: Shift differential paid for hours coded as day shift
Direct deposit changed twice within 48 hours from two different devices; second change pending verification
Overtime paid without area-manager approval on file
Garnishment order on file without matching deduction
Hours paid exceed hours worked per time clock
Dental Plus premium deducted while enrollment shows Dental Basic
Local tax withheld for a city the employee no longer works in

audit_memo.notes: Location 118 had two exceptions this quarter. Locations 131 and 140 were also flagged in Q2. Auditors recommend refresher training on overtime approvals for all store managers and a review of premium-pay coding at Location 112. Management responses are due to Internal Audit by 10/15.

code_legend.EX-01: Pay exceeds recorded hours - owner: Timekeeping
code_legend.EX-02: Overtime approval missing - owner: Store operations
code_legend.EX-03: Rate mismatch vs. compensation record - owner: Compensation
code_legend.EX-04: Premium pay coding error - owner: Timekeeping
code_legend.EX-05: Tax jurisdiction mismatch - owner: Payroll Tax
code_legend.EX-06: Garnishment not applied - owner: Payroll Operations
code_legend.EX-08: Terminated employee paid - owner: Payroll Operations
code_legend.EX-09: Payment-destination security hold - owner: Payroll Security
code_legend.EX-10: Missing tax withholding certificate - owner: Payroll Tax
